B0FX4G3ML2.title: THIRDREALITY Smart Garage Door Opener, Matter Certified, Retrofit with Existing Remote, Compatible with Alexa, Apple Home, Google Home, SmartThings, Home Assistant & Homey
bullets: Note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Matter Controller Required. Only or sectional (flip-up) garage doors.

Matter Certified Compatibility: Fully certified under the Matter protocol, enabling smooth integration with SmartThings Aeotec, Apple Home, Google, Home Assistant, Homey and Alexa. Connect and control within your favorite smart home ecosystem.

Key-based Control Design: Controls your garage door by leveraging the existing garage key interface, not the motor wiring. Works reliably across brands without being blocked by brand-specific security systems.

Effort-less Setup: No complex wiring or tools required. The opener and tilt sensor come pre-paired out of the box(Only for sectional (flip-up) garage doors). Just connect power via Type-C cable, insert your garage key, adjust position, and scan the QR code to complete setup. Compared to other smart garage door systems, it’s a budget-friendly option with simple operation.

Remote Control Anywhere：Control your garage door anytime, anywhere via your smartphone. Keep track of your garage door’s open/close status around the clock. Whether you’re out and about or at home, you can instantly view the door’s "open/close" state on your phone, and remotely close it with just one tap if needed.

Shared Access for the Whole Family: Grant access to family members through the app. No physical keys needed — everyone can operate the garage door easily and securely. Simple, safe, and convenient for everyday use.
